Following E20 fuel, we now have B5 diesel commonly referred to as 'biodiesel.' Just as E20 fuel is created by blending 20 percent ethanol into petrol, B5 diesel is produced by mixing 5 percent vegetable oil with 95 percent diesel. According to a report by Business Standard, the sale of this biodiesel has commenced at select petrol pumps across Delhi-NCR, Gujarat, and Rajasthan. However, it is not guaranteed that these pumps will display a specific logo for this type of diesel.
